events.result:
Batch 3 migrated, 40 records (120 migrated so far).
Validation note: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM
assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the 120
records migrated so far belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers in the
new CRM are wrong. Records from batches 4 to 10 will have the same problem.
New CRM activity: 14 sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

args.body: Migration paused after batches 1–3 (120/400 records). Validation reports that the old CRM omitted country codes and the new CRM added +1 to every number, leaving 31 overseas customers with incorrect phone numbers. Batches 4–10 would have the same problem. New CRM activity shows 14 sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours; whether they used affected numbers is unknown. Please alert sales not to rely on migrated overseas phone numbers, and arrange verified country codes plus a corrected import mapping before resuming. We need the affected customer IDs and verified numbers to repair the 31 records; I will not guess country codes. The remaining 280 records have not been migrated.
